relevance_note: Single case report of a man with a LAMP2 variant: 'the patient has a heterozygous lysosome-associated membrane protein 2 (LAMP2) gene mutation', 'supporting the diagnosis of Danon disease'.
method_note: Hand extraction of a one-patient letter (no tables); the JSON was assembled by a short Python script from values read by hand. Relatives in scope: parents (sex not stated individually, so 'parent of patient' and 'parent of patient 2'), two sisters (tested negative for LAMP2; normal ECG and Echo), and an uncle with unexplained sudden death at 47 (untested, side of family not stated; included as an affected relative described in relation to the patient). LAMP2 variant printed only as 'a G>A transition in base 928 of exon 7' (no c./p. notation, no transcript); MYBPC3 variant printed as 'G>A transition in base 122 of exon 2' and recorded as a second variant row for the patient; zygosity for MYBPC3 not stated. Paper calls the LAMP2 variant 'heterozygous' in a male; recorded as stated (possible inconsistency with X-linked hemizygosity, not corrected). De novo recorded because both parents (and two sisters) were genotyped negative for LAMP2. Relatives' 'no abnormal findings in ECG and Echo' recorded as excluded whole-examination findings only (D-27); checklist items left 'not reported' for them. 'Lacking skeletal myopathy' marked as excluding the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)'; 'lacking ... intellectual disorders' recorded as a feature but the composite checklist item 'intellectual disability, cognitive impairment or learning difficulties' left 'not reported' (narrow vs broad rule). Muscle biopsy showed vacuolization and glycogen deposition despite clinically 'lacking skeletal myopathy'; recorded both, not treated as a contradiction. Checklist 'elevated creatine kinase' marked observed from elevated CK-MB mass (total CK not reported). EPS failure to induce sustained tachycardia and 'no malignant events' at follow-up recorded as features, but SVT and VT/VF checklist items left 'not reported'. 'Heart dysfunction'/'LV dysfunction' not taken as 'heart failure'. Vital status of the patient left 'not reported' (follow-up at 6 months implies alive but not stated). Age at diagnosis not stated.
